what.text: This page follows refugees from Sudan living in Jordan, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 3151 Sudanese refugees in Jordan, 0.1% of all refugees from Sudan.
Chad hosts the most Sudanese refugees, followed by South Sudan, Libya and Ethiopia.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Sudan in periods from 1989 to 2025, with the RSF among the opponents since 2020.
It also records an interstate armed conflict between South Sudan and Sudan in 2012.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1994 at 6 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 3697, at the end of 2021; the main years of displacement in the data are 2016 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Jordan.
These are year-end totals for Jordan only, reported to UNHCR.
